question.text: A close-ended Cat III AIF (5-year tenure) has a lock-in of 2 years. The PPM specifies: exit loads of 3% in Year 3, 2% in Year 4, 1% in Year 5 for post-lock-in redemptions. An investor redeems INR 2 crore in Year 4 (at NAV Rs. 1,200, unit count 16,667 approx). What is the NET redemption?

explanation.text: **The Logic:** Gross redemption = INR 2 crore (as stated). Exit load in Year 4 = 2%. Net = INR 2,00,00,000 x (1 - 0.02) = INR 2,00,00,000 - 4,00,000 = INR 1,96,00,000. **The Trap:** Option B applies 1% (Year 5 rate) — wrong year. Option C ignores exit load. Option D over-deducts at 3% (Year 3 rate). **Cross-Exam Context:** Exit load schedules appear in mutual-fund / Cat II/III contexts; XIX-A/B/C/D/E all touch this. **Manager's Pro-Tip:** Always confirm the exit-load year mapping in the trust deed vs PPM — Year 3 starts at day 731 from first subscription, not from fund launch. Ambiguity here causes disputes.
